profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Conscientious software professional with considerable hands-on experience. A heartfelt team-player. Expertise in application development, database design, technical support and training. Strong Java programming skills and recent specialization in cryptography, Global Platform SCP02, and OTA payment card applet personalization.

Specialties: Software development, cryptographic key management, smart card personalization, technical instruction.

- Java, Python, C/C++, XML, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, Perl, LISP, and proprietary languages
- JavaCard development, HCE
- ISO 7813, ISO 7816, ISO 14443, GP 2.1.1, GP 2.2, SCP02
- PayPass, M/Chip, qVSDC, MPP and VMPA applet personalization, Mifare4Mobile
- NoSQL (Cassandra, Couchdb), SQL (Oracle, MySQL), Proprietary (Admins)
- JBoss, Tomcat, WebLogic

positions.title: Software Contractor
positions.description: Developed applications related to cryptographic key management, smart card personalization applications and test suites in Java and Python; produced accompanying specifications, procedures and user's guides.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Data modeling and application development for smart card projects.

positions.title: International Program Director / Technology Instructor
positions.description: Managed the school's International Student Support Program; taught Upper School technology electives (including HTMl, JavaScript, Microsoft Office Suite).

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught English in the French public school system; wrote thesis required for national certification.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed applications related to airline crew management, some Internet-based; trained users, wrote documentation and translated software (German and French to English).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborated with field engineers to produce requirements and specifications for new software for use during well testing operations; developed applications; trained users; prepared the well testing segment of a company-wide data model; wrote technical documentation.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Customized fund-raising database applications to meet the specific needs of our non-profit clients; trained users on new modules.

positions.title: Journalist
positions.description: Researched trends in worldwide telecommunications markets and wrote articles for The Telecommunications Development Report; setup an automated mailing system; served as de facto systems administrator for this small start-up.
